preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 500.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and n*(n-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'Yes' if len(return_value) == 2 and len(return_value[1]) == n and all(c in 'abc' for c in return_value[1]) else return_value[0] == 'No'
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'Yes', the second line must be a string of length n consisting of 'a', 'b', and 'c'. If the first line is 'No', there should be no second line.

postconditions.expression: all((u, v) in edges or (v, u) in edges if abs(ord(s[u-1]) - ord(s[v-1])) <= 1 else False for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: For each edge (u, v), the characters s[u-1] and s[v-1] must be either the same or adjacent in the alphabet.

postconditions.expression: all((u, v) not in edges and (v, u) not in edges if abs(ord(s[u-1]) - ord(s[v-1])) > 1 else True for u, v in [(i, j) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(i+1, n+1)])
postconditions.description: For each pair of vertices (u, v) without an edge, the characters s[u-1] and s[v-1] must not be adjacent in the alphabet.
